info.title: OpenWeb PBX Administration and Reseller API
info.description: Debian 1.0.26. Personal, department, PBX, tenant and instance scoped keys, tenant services, calling, templates, resources and recovery. Registration and domain authority remain in API v1. Prices are manual billing quotations; no payment gateway is configured.

servers.description: Hosted installation; self-hosted users substitute their installation hostname.

post.description: Required key scope: keys:manage. Current account ownership, role and tenant availability are checked on every request. Tenant and PBX are inherited from the calling key. Scopes must be a subset; expiry cannot exceed the parent. Parent revocation/rotation withdraws delegated descendants. API listing/rotation/revocation covers only self and descendants, never ancestors, siblings or independent UI keys. Personal/department keys use me:* or staff:* plus optional keys:manage and cannot mix in administrator scopes. Dashboard personal keys are automatically bound to the current web account’s PBX.

200.description: Completed read or accepted command; poll queued jobs for completion.

api_enabled.description: Instance-wide public v1 starter opt-in only. Must remain false for any template containing trunks/rules/settings. Tenant keys omit this field.

request_uuid.description: Idempotency reference. Retry the same service request with the same UUID; do not generate a new UUID on transport retry.

sip_domain.description: Optional validated SIP realm; omit to use the installation managed suffix policy. Domain registration/readiness remains in API v1 onboarding.

idempotency_key.description: Your unique order reference. The same reference must repeat the same quantities and requester. No price or approval field is accepted.

monthly_amount_cents.description: Server-calculated quotation. A PostgreSQL bigint may be returned as a decimal string.

password.description: 12–256 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters. Store separately from this server.

passphrase.description: At least 12 characters on first save. Blank retains the current password.

sftp_identity.description: SFTP private key. Only send when configuring remote SFTP storage.

invitation_url.description: One-use invitation path. Resolve it against the installation HTTPS URL and deliver privately.

owner.description: PBX administration only: empty for a company contact or an extension in this PBX. Personal endpoints always assign the key owner.
